authentic_anchors.retrieval: Successful original author-uploaded article PDF; uncorrected proof version as labelled in document.
authentic_anchors.location: Printed p.12 (PDF page index 11), typical example; Table 2. Report elicitation printed p.11.
authentic_anchors.provenance_class: Author-described typical example without participant or trial identifier; Table 2 aggregates interview-derived category descriptions.
authentic_anchors.paraphrase: The typical example identifies colour, shape and position while separately reporting clearer location, weak colour appearance and denied shape experience. Table 2 describes an interview-derived awareness scale including unspecified glimpses and differing vividness across attributes.
authentic_anchors.provisional_annotation: The typical example supplies C, M_presentation, S, P_presentation and claimed experiential wording, including negative shape polarity. Unspecified-glimpse category wording alone need not supply C. Table descriptions are aggregate definitions, not individually traceable trial reports.
authentic_anchors.validation_limit: Provisional linguistic anchor only; no representative-corpus validity or felt-truth assessment.

authentic_anchors.retrieval: Successful original PNAS article PDF mirror.
authentic_anchors.location: Printed p.1587, Training of subjects, S4 example; printed p.1588, first-person cluster descriptions.
authentic_anchors.provenance_class: Named S4 training quotation without trial identifier; readiness descriptions summarize clusters across trials.
authentic_anchors.paraphrase: S4 describes an image arriving near peripheral attention followed by the shape capturing attention. The clusters distinguish prepared continuity, fragmented preparation with surprise, and unprepared interruption associated with distraction.
authentic_anchors.provisional_annotation: S4 supplies content-bound attention timing and emergence language, but the cited training example alone does not supply a separate identity decision and strict P_presentation conjunction. Cluster summaries relate preparation to perception but are aggregate descriptions rather than a new corpus of participant trial reports.
authentic_anchors.validation_limit: Provisional linguistic anchors only; no human validation, prevalence, sensitivity or specificity claim.
